result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, unmarked residential street lacking basic infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or continuous, unobstructed sidewalks. Parked vehicles and the absence of lane markings create a hostile environment for pedestrians, with no clear separation from vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of continuous sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces due to the lack of a complete sidewalk network on both sides.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street and further down the left side.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: The black SUV parked on the left obscures the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the road.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Add lane markings to define travel lanes and consider speed humps or other traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a brick-paved sidewalk on one side but lacking continuous pedestrian infrastructure on the other. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible, creating potential conflicts between pedestrians and vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at a residential intersection increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree and parked vehicles near the corner may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner.

interventions.title: Install Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warnings to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the corner and manage vegetation to improve sightlines.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, including continuous sidewalks and standard marked crosswalks. While the low-traffic residential setting and good visibility provide some inherent safety, the absence of dedicated pedestrian space forces people to share the roadway with vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the roadway shared with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the visible roadways

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks standard crosswalk markings and traffic control signs, creating ambiguity regarding right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection where the two roads meet

interventions.title: Install Continuous Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or other traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds and clarify right-of-way at the junction.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with apartment buildings and a continuous sidewalk on one side. However, the environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings, traffic calming measures, and curb ramps, while parked vehicles create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to cross the street between residential buildings.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Cars parked along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the crossing.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install vertical speed control measures to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential area.
